lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Transfer challenge: similar triangles and slope

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: The example is from a different context than the problems below.

items.prompt: A line passes through (1, 2). A slope triangle on the line has a horizontal leg (run) of 3 and a vertical leg (rise) of 2. A similar slope triangle further along the same line is 2 times as large. Which point also lies on the line?

steps: The base slope triangle shows a slope of 2/3.
Scaling the triangle by 2 gives a run of 6 and a rise of 4 from (1, 2).

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A line has a slope of 5/9. A right triangle drawn along the line has a vertical leg (rise) of 16 units. What is the length of the other leg?
Write the equation, in slope-intercept form, of the line through (-20, 33) and (-15, 26).
Identify the slope and y-intercept of the line y = (-1/6)x - 5.

Relationship A (proportional):
x: 3, 6, 9
y: 10, 20, 30
Relationship B: y = 6x
Which relationship has the greater rate of change (unit rate)?
choices: The rate of change cannot be determined from this information.
They have the same rate of change.

items.prompt: For the line y = -10x + 12, find y when x = 14.

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: These are meant to be hard. Show the reasoning even if you do not finish.

items.prompt: A line has equation y = (7/6)x - 14. Which of these equations represents a line parallel to it?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A line has equation y = (-1/2)x - 12. Write the equation of the line through (-8, -12) that is parallel to this line.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A taxi fare is given by F = 17m + 10, where F is the total fare in dollars and m is the number of miles traveled. What does the slope represent in this context?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
